## Changes log:
**Khmer Calendar V1.0.5:**

## Added:
- Direct in-app download and install for updates (no browser required when a build is ready)
- More sounds
- Mouse / trackpad: horizontal scroll changes months
- Vertical wheel changes months when the page cannot scroll further
- Hold Alt + scroll: change months and block vertical page scroll
- Desktop update helpers for Windows, Linux and macOS (uploaded with each release)

## Bug fixes:
- (none in this release)

## Improvements:
- Month navigation with mouse and trackpad feels more natural on desktop
